Genuine residue is 2 same-file duplicate `visit` functions in src/analyzer/ast-element-scanner.ts (:162, :469) - too small and too different in kind to carry this WO.

cancel_metadata.why_by_hand: The registry `path` for this WO is anchor-prefixed ('coderef-core:coderef/workorder/...'). cancel-workorder's path resolver does not expand the anchor, so it took the ORPHAN branch and reported orphan=true even though the directory exists on disk. The orphan branch writes only a synthetic CANCEL-MARKER and skips the communication.json cancel_metadata block, so this block was added by hand and the directory was left in place rather than moved. Filed separately.
